_about: Phrasings you corrected once that must not come back. resume-builder/check.py tests every resume against these (on every build, and when Claude saves a draft). Each rule: a case-insensitive regex matched within one entry (summary, a job, a project, skills), why it's wrong, and what to write instead. Add "in" (a regex on the entry's label, like "Senior Product Manager") to apply a rule to one role only. The reasoning behind each lives in resume-notes.md. Claude adds a rule here whenever a correction is a phrase that could be reused. Delete the example rule once you have your own.

rules.why: Example: an internal codename nobody outside the company would recognize.
